error_categories.description: The trace answers a maximum-discrepancy question over four stores (Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, Albertsons) but only computes values for Whole Foods and Walmart. It does not evaluate or rule out Target and Albertsons, so the claimed maximum is not established.

The key chart values (cleanliness and value-for-dollar percentages) are presented as direct media readings from unseen charts without any explicit tool-attributed textual source. In text-only mode, those numeric chart readings are unsupported, so the later discrepancy calculations are not justified by the provided text alone.

summary: The trace reaches a clear conclusion, but it is not justified from text alone because the crucial chart values are unsupported direct media claims and the comparison is incomplete across the four stores named in the question.
